rounds.title: Scores for this stage
rounds.heatHelp: Darker cells mean a higher average rating (out of 5). Weights are shown under each criterion.
rounds.empty: No entries have been given to judges in this stage yet.
rounds.emptyHelp: The admin chooses judges on the challenge's Judges tab.
rounds.blockedBecause: The shortlist can't be proposed yet:
rounds.readOnly: Read only. Only the program owner can propose the shortlist or resolve disagreements.
rounds.frozen: Scores are locked because the shortlist was confirmed.
rounds.disagreeIntro: Two judges differ by {{threshold}} points or more on the criteria marked below. Discuss with the panel, then record how it was resolved.
rounds.resolutionNoteHelp: This note is saved in the audit log.
rounds.noteRequired: Record how the disagreement was resolved.

shortlist.title: Shortlist manager
shortlist.reasonHelp: Required when your decision differs from the rule. It is logged and shown on this page.
shortlist.reasonRequired: Give a reason for changing the system's decision.
shortlist.prototypeAsk: Ask this entry for a working prototype
shortlist.prototypeReasonHelp: For example: high technical risk, must prove feasibility first.
shortlist.rerunBody: This recalculates the shortlist from the current scores and removes your overrides.
shortlist.confirmBody: This locks all scores and decisions for this round. You can't change them afterwards. Entrants are not told until you publish.
shortlist.publishBody: Every entrant gets an email and sees their decision and feedback. This can't be undone.
shortlist.readOnly: Read only. Only the program owner can change, confirm or publish the shortlist.
shortlist.lockedConfirmed: Confirmed. Scores and decisions are locked. Publish when the feedback is ready.
shortlist.lockedPublished: Published. Entrants can see their decision and feedback.
shortlist.composerIntro: Judges' shared strengths and improvements are gathered here. Edit them into one clear message per entry. Judges' names are never shown to entrants.
shortlist.composerEmpty: No feedback drafts yet. They appear when reviews are submitted.
shortlist.showOnlyMissing: Show only entries with missing feedback

resultsDecision.title: Results and awards
resultsDecision.humanNote: The jury decides. Scores below are guidance only — a person records the decision, a person approves it, and nothing is published automatically.
resultsDecision.pendingReviews: {{count}} jury reviews are not submitted yet. You can record the decision, but scores may still change.
resultsDecision.notePlaceholder: Why the jury chose this entry
resultsDecision.evidenceRule: A top award needs working evidence. This entry has no working solution submitted.
resultsDecision.approveBody: You confirm the jury's decision. Results still stay private until you publish them.
resultsDecision.publishBody: Winners are announced to everyone, rewards are created and split by credit share, and every finalist gets feedback. This can't be undone.
resultsDecision.preview: Preview of the public results page
resultsDecision.previewNote: Only winners are listed publicly. Other entries are never shown.
resultsDecision.alreadyContinued: This entry already continues as an initiative.
resultsDecision.emptyHelp: Finalists appear here after the final submissions are in.
resultsDecision.readOnly: Read only. Only the program owner can record, approve or publish results.
resultsDecision.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
